notes.title: Hotfix for crashes
notes.content:
There has been a surge of crashes in the game recently. 

I believe they have to do with the new features of vampire, which also occurs during the chi attack, and so vampire has been removed from the game for now.

This bug is elusive... it only occurs during release builds. That's why I didn't catch it before when developing it. And there's no crash report at all for it. I'm still working on figuring out why it's happening. A fix should be easy once I figure it out.

I've also removed drag upgrades, as shot drag was recently removed from the game as well to increase performance. This might still be temporary.

If you still experience crashes, please let me know when and how it happens. You can either post in the discussion forums on Steam, reply to this message, or let me know on the Dualism Discord channel. (Pst, that's the best way to contact me)
https://discord.gg/768waPBAAw

Apologies for the buggy game with bugs about bugs.

notes.title: Back from sickness - Dualism is Dragless!
notes.content:
Every once in a while I like to try crazy experiments and change up the gameplay a lot.

This time, I took away air drag for shots. 

I had previously thought the slight exponential change in speed for shots was cool and more natural, but I think this linear, constant speed is better for gaming, and it will likely result in better performance.

So, let me know what you think! I may keep it this way and polish up all the shots speeds for next update. This update, the lack of drag had resulted in changes in speeds for all shots. I have not yet fine tuned these. It's rough. Happy re-exploring! Something different for a while.

[h2]It's been like three weeks, what happened to you?![/h2]
I'm not sure. I had an ear infection that turned into a really bad fever for a few days, I think. It was the worst I've felt in years. But when it finally went away, it still took me a while to feel 100% normal. In fact, I still feel lethargic and like my brain isn't working like it was before. I went from super productive to super lazy. Gotta 'nother problem to fix now. Myself.

[h2]How are the upgrade stats going?[/h2]
Physical door upgrades was completed. 
New upgrade: Take and give physical hits more often
Returning upgrade: Enemies take physical hits more often

[h2]What else?[/h2]
Water bugs have stopped taking a nap mid-game. This bug also affected the attraction upgrades, so all of these will work much better when there's a lot of enemies on the screen.

Fixed: not dealing the same amount of damage on collision with reflection

Fixed: Bombs drop in every direction on hit 

Slight optimization in calculating enemy health, xp, dmg

Fixed: Ant collision stun length was getting reduced twice when it was injured

~~~

Good luck, and have fun with the new shot speeds this week!

notes.title: Performance down, stability up
notes.content:
[b]Don't upgrade if you want maximum performance at the risk of crashing.[/b]

[h2]Instance pooling turned off[/h2]
I think instance pooling, a technique for optimizing framerate when there's a TON of shots on the screen, was slightly instable, and causing weird behavior and crashes sometimes.

I removed this optimization for this build. So there will be about a 10% decrease in performance.

For example, with instance pooling, and 2500 shots on the screen, 65 fps.
Without instance pooling, and same 2500 shots on the screen, 57 fps.

If you still experience any crashes (especially ones without an error report) LET ME KNOW!

[h2]Shots upgrade[/h2]
Also, by request, increased the maximum number of times you can get the "Shots do more damage" upgrade

[h2]Week off[/h2]
I have been struggling with the game updates for the last couple of weeks. I think I need to take a week off, let my creative energy refill, and, probably more importantly, take care of a bunch of things outside of the game that I've been putting off. These things have been nagging me ([i]you need to do this![/i]) constantly for weeks, so I'm going to try and get a bunch of these things done. All to say, there may not be an update at the end of this week. This week, I'm not requiring myself to push an update. I apologize for the delay.

On another note, one of these things will be setting up my office for streaming. So after this I can do things like live coding / streaming.

But anyway, good luck and have fun. See ya in a week or two.

notes.title: Upgrade Stats, part 4: Lightning,. and more Optimization
notes.content:
"Ahhh motherland!"

This week was focused on getting more upgrade stats done, and I got sidetracked with more optimizations. Good thing though, I think there were some interesting ones made that I hadn't thought of before. Getting closer to fully optimized.

[h2]Someone want to test me on that?[/h2]
I believe this version is about 20% more performant than last week's game. 

[h2]What's are this week's Upgrade Stats?[/h2]
[h1]Lightning[/h1]
There were a concerning amount of bugs in the lightning code. For example, it wouldn't even work when there was just two bugs. Now it does, it should chain a lot more, and everything, including those blasted blast sizes, will reduce after each chain. It's optimized as well. Everything is getting a nice coat of optimization now.

[h2]What the heck is going on with these particles?[/h2]
Yeah, they were changed. I was given advice on a different method to do them, and at first, I implemented them with a bug that didn't calculate shot sizes correctly. Then I liked the effect, and decided to keep that bug in the code. It's cleaner. It's also more performant.

[h2]Those who don't believe performant is a word will be culled[/h2]
As much as I wish, again, that more of these upgrade stats were done... one day they will be completed for all 120 or so. The thing is I'm rewriting where all these values are calculated and making sure they're much more consistent. I'm also going over all the math again, and even rebalancing them in many cases. Then it gets crazy with how everything is linked in the game. For example, these are the things that make lightning that all had to be updated and tested: player collisions, all 8 or so shot styles, bombs, chi attack, mosquitos, spikes, spikes made by balls and shields, shields, and balls. Oh and don't forget testing with that last boss! I'm guessing two more weeks to finish these upgrade stats.

Good luck, and have fun.

notes.title: Midweek update: fixes and optimizes
notes.content:
Yoooo

Another week, another mid-week update. (doh!)

[h2]Fix[/h2]
There were some crashes happening due to all the sprites I deleted in the last update. This should be fixed now.

[h2]Optimize[/h2]
I included some optimizations I have been working on. Something called "instance pooling", so certain engine procedures are skipped when creating and destroying thousands of projectiles per second.

And it was a success! I'm seeing anywhere from 5-20% framerate boosts from it.

[h2]Reworking[/h2]
Particles have also changed. I am trying something else to optimize them. A bug in the code caused the particles to look the way they do, and... I kind of like it. So I'm keeping it this way for now. Let me know what you think. Cleaner might be better, when the game is already super-chaotic. 

[h3]Be aware[/h3]
Poison, slow, etc, currently don't show in shot particles. Particles are a work in progress, and I wanted to push this update out quickly to fix the game crashes.

Enjoy~

notes.title: Titan Boss Update
notes.content:
[h1]A new boss - The Titan Beetle![/h1]
You may "run" into him ;)
He is a very physical boss that relies more on his SHIELD and smashing into you. Chaos, of course, as well. Combined with his diplomatic assets, it's likely he's even more difficult than Harry Legs.

Bosses in general were rewritten a lot. You won't see it, but I made changes that will come in future updates. Future ways to make the game easier or more difficult. The bosses will be able to stack more attacks at a time, for example.

Bosses now announce their moves, "just like my Japanese anime!" This should help players learn not only their attacks, but also [i]how the boss attack system works[/i]. 

[h2]What else?[/h2]
Several smaller items:

[h3]Mouse captured[/h3]
No more clicking outside the window. If you need to move the window, you can unlock the mouse by pressing ALT+1. This is also mentioned in Video options.

[h3]MothMind stronger[/h3]
I was getting tired of people telling me MothMind was easy. He's slightly stronger, slightly sturdier, and twice as parasitic.

[h3]Bombs un-buffed[/h3]
Last update had fairly significant upgrades in strength to bombs. It's been set back to previous weeks' values.

[h3]Emergency Teleport fixed[/h3]
Not just fixed. Made better. It had to be modified when it's triggered. Much better balanced now. You can get the upgrade up to three times, at which point you'll teleport to safety whenever you touch something. The area you teleport to is searched for enemies before you teleport. Much better, at least. Most importantly, your balls teleport with you now. Who would use a teleporter if your balls didn't travel with you?!

Importantly, this upgrade was moved from Physical to the Time and Aero doors. It didn't make sense in Physical, since it basically prevents you from developing a very powerful physical build by teleporting you to safety as soon as you get physical.

[h3]Spikes balanced[/h3]
Spikes are a strong tool. But they actually were OP with many spikes and balls. You could create 30+ spikes a second that way. Now, spikes can only be made every 3/4 second, no matter how many spikeable attacks you have.

[h3]New engine[/h3]
Updated to a new GameMaker Studio engine. Supposedly, framerates could increase.

[h3]GMLive[/h3]
If you look in the game files, you'll see GMLive. It's just a tool to help me develop much better. I can see updates in the game without having to recompile, which should make development much faster. I'm excited for it. 

[h3]Shots can go out of bounds[/h3]
Before, I was deleting shots as soon as they left the screen. Now there's a buffer, so tracking shots have some room to come back in.

[h3]Player shown on pause and upgrade screens[/h3]
This was done so you have more information about where your avatar is when you are quickly thrown back into the chaos. Believe it or not, this is also a step toward the main focus next week, which will be:

[h3]Next week: stat change information when looking at the different upgrades[/h3]

Good luck and have fun. Don't let Titan beat you around too much.

notes.title: Extremely Strong Bombs Update
notes.content:
[h2]COMMUNITY INPUT[/h2]
I had a request to make bombs strong. Even though I think they were already plenty strong, I want to encourage community input. So I obliged:
[list]
[*] Bomb strength 10% stronger
[*] Bomb fragments 20% stronger
[*] Bombs propel better nerfed. Slower, and it takes 10% of the damage away
[*] [fix] standardized bomb ttl (how long it stays on screen) so it's short no matter what starting build you choose
[/list]

I had another request to make the game endless after the final boss.
[h3]REQUEST FULFILLED[/h3]
There's an option to go endless during the last boss now.
Speaking of bosses: there's now 2 bonus upgrades for every boss killed

It... looks different...
[list]
[*] New custom-made font unique to Dualism
[*] Replaced fonts used for damage numbers with these
[*] XP gained shows on kill
[*] Bonus upgrades show on player on boss kills
[/list]

Finished up the Shields from last week.
[list]
[*] Shields pass status effects (lightning, slow, poison, blast, etc)
[*] -- For the above, the shield counts as a physical hit
[*] Shields have hit flashes
[*] Shields have collision sfx
[*] Shield stat tweaking to make them better in every way
[*] Shield challenges in the Challenges screen
[*] Fixed shield collisions code (I don't know- this is all I wrote in my notes)
[/list]

Screw sucked. It was too small and required several size upgrades to be useful. I made screwing better.
[list]
[*] Base screw area about 2x larger
[*] Screw semi-transparent so you can see who you're screwing
[*] Blast due to screw hits happens on enemies, not player
[/list]

Lightning reworked/recoded
Before, lightning occured all during the same frame. This made it hard to tell how it traveled and how much damage it did.
Now, after an overhaul, every chain of lightning has several frames in between, so you can kind of see it propagate. It's still pretty fast though.
I think I solved some unknown lightning bugs too. Lightning might be much stronger now... 
Also made it so the correct type of poison or slow travels through lightning based on if the lightning was started with a physical hit or spirit energy.

That's it. I know. No new boss. The teleport upgrade is still broken. Attraction is way too strong. I think these things will all be fixed in the next update.
Taxes got in the way. Yeah. That's my excuse. Definitely not my ADHD brain.
I also keep talking about being able to see the individual stat increases for each upgrade. Can't promise it for next week, it's a big task- I have to rewrite calculations for every upgrade. 

I hope you all enjoy!

Post in the discussions other requests you'd like to see. VERY high chance your request will be fulfilled. (Someone should ask for something ridiculous at this point)

notes.title: SHIELD
notes.content:
It's Friday!

What's in the update?

[h2]A new Door: Shield![/h2]
Two weeks in a row with new doors! I'm was excited/exhausted, I accidentally forced the shield door to appear in the door selection screen until it's selected. So you have plenty of chances to try it!

The shield can be a defensive tool or a physically offensive weapon. It sits around the player, blocking dangerous shots, but letting shots of the same color in to heal you. It also damages and pushes back enemies. But each piece of the shield (it can be broken up!) has hp and a cooldown, so charge in wisely...
[list]
[*] Upgrade: Shield covers more
[*] Upgrade: Shield rotates
[*] Upgrade: Shield has more hp
[*] Upgrade: Shield rebuilds faster
[*] Upgrade: Shield does more damage
[*] Upgrade: Shield is more pieces
[*] It currently does not pass status effects but in the future it will.
[*] There is a new boss coming that utilizes the shield (next week).
[*] I think I forgot the challenges to max out the shield upgrades. That'll be next week too.
[/list]

[h2]What else?[/h2]
Sorry, not too much. The shield really took it out of me this week! Sometimes programming is just like running your head into a wall, over and over. But we have some more things coming... More general conceptual plans have been made, as well as multi-week projects like new bgm and fonts
[list]
[*] Bees should be less deadly now. Less poison, but now they slow too.
[*] New font and background music in the works.
[*] Known bug: The upgrade to teleport when in danger- it's too sensitive. Do it max one time, but I'd stay away for now.
[*] There's over 100 different upgrades available now, all to max out and make the game go bananas in unique ways!
[/list]

Good luck and have fun.

notes.content:
Hiya banana!

What's in the update?

[h2]A new Door: Charged Shots![/h2]
Charged shots take all the damage that you would normally do per second and compress it into one powerful shot.
[list]
[*] Charge More
[*] Charge Faster

[h2]New Diplomacy / Recruit Upgrades![/h2]
The diplomacy door got a bunch of upgrades. Base strength and health of the recruits are diminished, but they can now become much stronger. And mosquitos are smart now! They'll automatically aim at the closest enemy to either themselves or the player. Furthermore, some recruits can be the opposite color as you- to make sure you always have some recruits fighting. [list]
[*] Recruits Are Stronger
[*] Recruits Have More Health
[*] Recruits Are Opposite Color
[*] Mosquitos Protect Player

[h2]Bombs Away![/h2]
There's also a new update for bombs that makes it so they fire when you fire. Combined with propelled bombs, it's a really strong combo!

[h2]What else?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Particles can be turned up/down in Video Options
[*] Reduced volume on friendly mosquito shots
[*] Multiple backgrounds appear at once. Ironically, this cleaned up the background and I found it easier to keep track of what's going on in the foreground with the bugs and shots.

Good luck and have fun.

notes.title: "No more One Shotted" Update
notes.content:
Tired of building a sweet killer dragonfly only to get obliterated by something you thought you were relatively safe from?

Me too!

Various game balances were put in to try to reduce the chance of this, most importantly:

[h3]Max damage per second[/h3]
Players now have max damage per second capped at 35% of their health. So it should take 3 seconds of total obliteration to finally finish players off now. There's a little breathing room to get out of dodge and get some health now.

Along with a [b]New Upgrade[/b], which reduces max damage per second by 5% each upgrade.

[h3]Loading screen with gameplay tips[/h3]
Just something to round off the game a bit. There's a lot of strategy involved, and hopefully this will continue to teach players after they finish the tutorial.

[h3]Doors have more information[/h3]
[list]
[*] Open a Door screen has tips now, giving a little more information and strategy about the various doors as you hover over them.
[*] Holding Shift, L1, or R1 on this screen shows you which upgrades are behind the doors. Less mystery, yay!
[*] Fixed the placement of the already-opened-door icons on this screen too
[/list]

[h3]Various game balances[/h3]
[list]
[*] Spider boss has his legs set back a little bit, to give the player more room to roam during the fight
[*] Giant mosquito and kissing bugs had their damage reduced a little, since I kept seeing players getting surprise-obliterated by them. These are some of the "Scary Bugs", if you know what I mean, James and Lee
[*] Disabled the wider and narrower spread/straight shots until you have multiple of those types of shots. I kept seeing players grab them when they were useless. I need to communicate these upgrades' effects better, but this should be a start.
[*] Very slightly easier scaling overall. (Probably, especially with the new Max Damage Per Second stat...)
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay change[/h3]
Screw no longer goes through webs or ants. That was a relic of when screw cost stamina, and stamina is no more. So screw was getting a little over powered in that regard.

There's a little "suggestion" for gun to use- the cursor starts in a random place. Might give 10% more exp for this random selection in the future...

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Sfx fix when you end the game with screw on
[*] Wrong sfx was used moving to select gun screen
[*] 'Max focus achieved' messages (achievement unlocked, basically) now appears even when the story is turned off
[/list]

[h3]Linux update[/h3]
Tested proton- sorry, it doesn't work. I'll have to start making linux builds when more requests are made for it.

notes.title: Massive Rebalancing Update!
notes.content:
[h3]It's basically a new game...[/h3]

So not ALL goals were met this week. I have not put in new code to prevent redundant assets that cause slowdown when the player gets [b]god-tier[/b] powerful.

[i]HowEVER![/i] Literally everything in the game changed. I put aside two days this week for making the game more [b]FUN![/b]

[h1]Massive Rebalancing[/h1]
In order to appeal to first timers better, I made the game easier to pick up and play. I realized that I was hitting new players over the head too hard and - yeah - why would they keep coming back? The game needs a learning curve, and I'm starting to put that in. 

You'll notice immediately some of the changes. 

[h2]Better initial stats - The Machine Gunner[/h2]
[list]
[*] Shoot further
[*] Shoot faster
[*] Shoot more often (2x)
[*] Shots do less damage (2x)
[*] Better turn speed
[/list]

This could be the start of different initial stats, like- choose your ship before you enter the battlefield.

Yes these are [i]massive changes in the gameplay[/i], and it's my intention to keep doing this throughout development. [u]So please let me know what you think![/u] These updates are coming at the requests of players, so make your voice heard!

[h2]What else was rebalanced?[/h2]
[list]
[*]More bugs, but they're all easier to kill
[*]Enemies scale up slower for HP and damage
[*]Reduced most enemy HPs
[*]Your healing scales up slower as well
[*]Boss waves come sooner
[*]Bosses scale separately from regular bugs, and harder
[*]Every enemy that shoots multiple shots at once had their damage halved
[*]Players should be blindsided by death less often now and have more time to GTFO of whatever is killing them rapidly
[*]Poison hits three times as often at three times less power
[*]Common flies easier
[*]Bees, since they are so much harder than flies, are a higher level bug now
[*]Chasing beetles have much less health
[*]Giant mosquitos are easier to kill
[*]Screw half as strong
[*]Spikes hit more removed as it's OP
[/list]


[h2]What else changed that wasn't a rebalance?[/h2]
[list]
[*][art] New background!
[*][art] Swaps between backgrounds are smooth as silk and different each run
[*][art] Doors opened appear on Open Door and Upgrade Screens
[*][info] Upgrade screen shows how many times you've got each upgrade and which one is the mutation (an upgrade outside of your evolutionary path)
[*][info] Tips show what level your current upgrade is
[*][story] Story now plays in order!
[*][story] Story plays every three minutes, instead of every 7 waves.
[*][rework] Better collisions code- less likely to get spammed and spam enemies with physical hits
[*][fix] Collisions went soft and lifeless in the last update. That's fixed. Sorry about that.
[*][rework] Attraction reworked so it constantly pulls enemies in. [i]Try it! It's fun![/i]
[*][upgrade] New Upgrade! Screw attracts!
[*][upgrade] New Upgrade! Spikes attract!
[*][upgrade] New Upgrade! Mines last longer!
[*][fix] No more crash when a wrecking ball creates a spike with vampire effect that hits an enemy of the opposite polarity that's supposed to give HP back to the player
[*][fix] Massive god-tier mine explosions don't kill off-screen enemies waiting to spawn in

notes.title: Dualism This Week - 1/25/2021
notes.content:
It's been a little more than one week since Dualism released, and there's already been a good amount of new content added! 

Let's keep that train moving!!

[h2]WEEK 2![/h2]

ART: Another new background! I hope you guys think these new backgrounds are as cool as I think they are.

INFO: First pass on bestiary and/or upgrade information screen - I realize there's a lot of mystery out there and I need to remedy that

BALANCE: Better initial stats. There's been feedback that says the game is a little too difficult and frustrating (maybe even infuriating) for newcomers. I'm going to fiddle with initial stats and maybe even hit boxes to make the initial experience a little bit better.

BALANCE: Collision code tweaking - better physical invuln code that makes more sense

UPGRADE FIX: "Pulls in enemies" will work more like constant gravity wells while the thing exists rather than throwing things around (in sometimes unwanted ways)

ART: Show doors opened on Upgrade Screen

FIX: Prevent slowdown when there's tons of homing, penetration, explosions, lightning, and hit sprites

STORE: A slightly optimized trailer

STORE: Screenshots with more backgrounds, and more cool gifs

MISC: Along with many other small stability / balance things. (I'll always say this)

These are the goals for this week! Detailed update notes to follow.

[h2]BONUS GOALS![/h2]
I'd really like to fit these into the next update as well. Can't promise them, but I'll try. Likely we won't see them all but hopefully we'll see some of them.

BOSS: Titan Beetle

UPGRADE: Shield

UPGRADE: Dash

UPGRADE: Burst shot

UPGRADE: Option (think Gradius)

UPGRADE: Charge shot (There's a lot of thinking that will have to be done so burst shot and charge shot make sense and are useful)

notes.title: Dualism This Week - 1/18/2021
notes.content:
Dualism released in early access last week! Special thanks to all the first purchasers!!

As promised, there will be continued development.

And as part of that promise, I'll try to keep you updated on what is planned and accomplished week to week.

[h2]WEEK 1![/h2]

ART: A new background! A great new artist will be making original paintings, ones that are long enough to scroll on for *wow* scrolling backgrounds ;) It's got some cool spirals and fractals that contribute to the spiritual journey theme the game has.

BALANCE: Slow is UP right now, time to make it more useful!

UPGRADE: a new one: Screw attack! Think Samus.

ART: New blast sprites. Currently there's just one that gets stretched pretty far. Soon there will be many sizes, offering cooler explosions ;)

ART & UPGRADE: Spike overhaul - New sprites, new math, new upgrades.

MISC: 'Safe' Achievements.

MISC: Along with many other small stability / balance things. (I'll always say this)

These are the goals for this week! Detailed update notes to follow.
